title: Fix pull request Snapshot context linkage
summary: Pull request review now discovers Snapshot and Plan records across local Git worktrees, treats the separate eve history commit and validated target-branch sync merges as part of the same current product context, preserves stale Snapshot links for accurate status, and requires a current Snapshot plus Plan reference for the default eve review queue. PR #35 now appears with its real scope blocker instead of an incorrect Snapshot-required state.
userVisibleChange: eve-related pull requests with valid Snapshot and Plan context now appear in the lowercase eve review queue, even when their records live in another worktree and the PR includes the required history commit or a validated target-branch merge. Stale linked Snapshots are shown as stale instead of missing.

risks.title: Generated UI bundles are excluded from product-delta comparison
risks.mitigation: Their tracked UI source remains included in the exact normalized comparison, and npm run build regenerated the embedded bundle during verification.

decisions.title: Match product context rather than raw head equality
decisions.rationale: The required two-commit eve workflow means a PR head normally follows the implementation commit with a .eve history commit. Target-branch sync merges are also accepted only when the normalized product delta remains identical.

decisions.title: Keep stale Snapshot identity
decisions.rationale: A branch-linked Snapshot is still useful context when later product changes make it stale; preserving the link lets the PR page explain the real state instead of saying no Snapshot exists.

decisions.title: Require a Plan reference in the primary queue
decisions.rationale: The default review queue should contain PRs with the minimum context eve needs: a current Snapshot and associated Plan revision. Evidence failures remain visible as review blockers.

validation.output: All Go packages passed, including the cross-worktree, history-commit, target-merge, conflict-resolution, and stale-link regression coverage.
TypeScript checking and the production Vite build passed; embedded UI assets were regenerated.
npm package dry-run succeeded with the expected five files.

Verified lowercase eve review queue, one contextual PR, PR #35 listed with its Snapshot title, 14 non-contextual PRs behind the disclosure, and the overview banner showing the actual scope-drift blocker.
